stem:
Meena keeps a bottle of clear lime water open on her kitchen shelf. After some time, the liquid turns milky.

The gas from the air that reacts with the lime water is ……1…… .

The milkiness is caused by tiny insoluble particles of ……2…… .

Which words correctly complete gaps 1 and 2?

teacher.key_rationale: Lime water (calcium hydroxide solution) turns milky in air because carbon dioxide reacts with it to form insoluble calcium carbonate particles. Gap 1 = carbon dioxide, gap 2 = calcium carbonate, so option B is correct. Options A and D trap students who pick the most familiar gas in air (oxygen); option C traps students who name the reactant (calcium hydroxide) as the milky product instead of the insoluble calcium carbonate formed.
